description.zh:
待提取水印的视频文件。

> - OSS文件/媒资的地域需要与当前IMS所在地域保持一致。
description.en:
The video file for watermark extraction.

> - The region of the Object Storage Service (OSS) file or media asset must match the region of the current Intelligent Media Service (IMS) instance.

description.zh:
水印任务参数，JSONString。目前支持设置参数如下：

- algoType：算法类型，默认值为v1。提取算法类型需和嵌入时使用的算法类型一致。

  - v1：长视频版权提取接口。
  - v2：短视频版权提取接口。
description.en:
The watermark job parameters, specified as a JSON string.

- algoType: The algorithm type. Default value: v1. The extraction algorithm type must match the algorithm type used for embedding the watermark.

  - v1: The copyright extraction algorithm for long-form videos.

  - v2: The copyright extraction algorithm for short-form videos.

description.zh: 用户自定义数据，最大长度1024字节。
description.en: The user-defined data. The maximum length is 1,024 bytes.

title.zh: 提交版权水印提取作业

descriptions.zh:
- 目前数字水印相关接口只支持华东2（上海）、华北2（北京）地域使用。
- 该接口为[异步接口](~~3027141~~)，提交任务后返回任务ID（此时任务尚未完成，任务将进入后台排队异步执行），最终结果将通过回调通知，也可通过[查询版权水印提取作业](~~2862132~~)主动查询任务状态。
descriptions.en:
- The digital watermark APIs are available only in the China (Shanghai) and China (Beijing) regions.

- This is an [asynchronous interface](~~3027141~~). After you submit a job, the service returns a job ID. The service then queues the job for asynchronous processing. You can get the final results through a [callback notification](~~3027141~~) or query the job status by calling the [QueryCopyrightExtractJob](~~2862132~~) operation.
